registration_timing: after D3b frozen-dev outcomes and GovReport-centered repositioning, before test membership, test payload, test references, test predictions, or test scores are accessed
unlock_requirements: E1 published-evaluator conformance completed without reversing the frozen GovReport primary comparison
E2 controlled cold/warm runtime, memory, and scaling report completed
E3 route/provenance ablation completed and manuscript claims downgraded where required
GovReport official-test canonical policy, membership count, exclusions, source checksums, fingerprint, and license are pinned before any model score
final code commit, dependency lock, hardware manifest, output paths, and exact commands are frozen
teacher and full author group sign the freeze recommendation
a dry-run guard proves that no command can resolve a non-test or unpinned test policy by accident

frozen_proposed_system.candidate_contract: route_top_k=40, requested min_per_route=20, total=80, weighted RRF lexical=0.5
frozen_proposed_system.seeds: deterministic one-shot; seed remains 3407 for any deterministic tie or library call
frozen_proposed_system.allowed_test_time_change: replace validation policy/partition fields with the signed test policy only; no scientific field may change

frozen_baselines.lead: document-order first-fit under the 500-650 word contract

random.method: seeded random order first-fit under the same contract
random.report: per-seed and seed-mean; no seed may be dropped

frozen_baselines.sbert_mmr: full-source SBERT+MMR lambda_relevance=0.9; preregistered primary adversarial comparator
frozen_baselines.trained_models: May be listed in a separate literature/trained-system context table only if locally reproduced under a separately frozen protocol; they do not enter the no-task-training primary hypothesis.

paper_authoritative_protocol.tokenization: Stanza tokenize,mwt with tokens joined by spaces and sentences by newlines
paper_authoritative_protocol.rouge: original Perl ROUGE-1.5.5 through pyrouge Rouge155
paper_authoritative_protocol.macro: unweighted mean of the three Average_F values

evaluation.secondary_protocol: current internal multisentence_lsum evaluator, reported for continuity but not used to replace an unfavorable official result
evaluation.failed_or_infeasible_rows: retained with the frozen F-17 contract; no row deletion after score observation
evaluation.summary_length: report mean, median, min, max, and full distribution for every system

confirmatory_inference.primary_hypothesis: proposed official-protocol macro minus full-source SBERT+MMR lambda-0.9 macro is greater than zero
confirmatory_inference.primary_test: 100,000 paired bootstrap resamples of per-row official-protocol differences, seed 20260830, percentile 95% CI and finite-corrected two-sided p
confirmatory_inference.primary_success: point delta >0, CI lower >0, and p<=0.05
confirmatory_inference.component_guard: For R1/R2/RL, Holm-adjust three component p-values; no component may have a 95% CI upper below zero
confirmatory_inference.secondary_family: 8 proposed-versus-baseline comparisons x R1/R2/RL/macro = 32 Holm-adjusted endpoints; descriptive support, not a replacement primary hypothesis
confirmatory_inference.random_baseline_inference: pair against the fixed 10-seed per-row mean and also report every seed
confirmatory_inference.selection_disclosure: The domain, proposed candidate, and primary adversarial baseline were selected from frozen dev evidence after the original dual-primary gate failed; the untouched test is the confirmatory check.

decision_rule.pass: Primary success holds, no component guard is violated, official-evaluator E1 did not reverse the dev comparison, and every execution/provenance audit passes.
decision_rule.fail: Report the final result and stop; do not change the candidate, baseline parameters, length, evaluator, exclusions, or inference after test access.
decision_rule.claim_scope_if_pass: GovReport long single-document no-task-training setting only; Multi-News remains a negative boundary condition.
decision_rule.never_authorized: cross-dataset SOTA, general extractive-summarization superiority, or NSGA-II-as-best claims

execution.resume: only exact checkpoint resume after infrastructure interruption; no scientific config change
artifacts: signed test data policy and preflight
per-row predictions, selected indices, feasibility and provenance
paired inference with all declared endpoints
dependency, hardware, date, commit, and exact command evidence
